signal: Exact-main production deployed successfully and /company-brain passed public route checks, but canonical pricing NL→EN browser roundtrip timed out on the language-option click.
root_cause: The public language option persisted locale state but relied on the browser's implicit anchor default after mobile navigation/menu state mutated during the same click. In production that default navigation was not reliable.
fix: Public language-option clicks now prevent implicit navigation and explicitly call location.assign() with the canonical localized href after closing menus.
prevention: Never rely on implicit anchor navigation for the public locale switch
Keep cross-page NL→EN→NL production browser proof fail-closed
Classify locale-click timeout as runtime interaction defect, not Netlify transport failure

evidence.observed_failure: page.waitForURL timeout during NL→EN public language click on /prijzen
